channel.description: The IRC channel name to generate statistics for.

cchannels.description: List of specific channels to process. Overrides 'channel' if provided.

logfile.description: Path to the single IRC log file to parse.

outfile.description: The path and filename for the generated HTML statistics page.

tag.description: A tag string to replace %t in the outfile name or title.

maintainer.description: Name of the channel or statistics maintainer to display.

format.description: Format of the input logfile (e.g., weechat, irssi, mirc).

dir.description: List of directories containing log files to analyze.

nfiles.description: Number of the last files to analyze if used with dir.

prefix.description: List of prefixes to filter files within the directory.
